name: NURS 4301
title: Concepts and Theories of Nursing Practice
description: The nurse’s role is explored in the context of the health care delivery systems, interprofessional and collaborative teams, health beliefs, practices and cultural needs of diverse patients, and legal and ethical issues in providing care. Nursing history, patterns of knowing, theory, and concepts of evidence-based practice are discussed as the foundation of nursing praxis.
requirement_description: NURS 4304, which may be taken concurrently; students must be accepted into the CEIN/B.S. program. Students must earn at least a grade of “C” in this course to progress.
